text:
maria_gomez: Pushed microq-v2-int8 to the canary pool ~2h ago. Quick heads up - funcall tests are spiking on structured-output compliance. Sample below.

devon_h: uhh can you paste the exact output? parser error or non_json? :thinking: 

maria_gomez: Not a hard parse error. It's valid-ish JSON but fields come back in different order and args sometimes has a trailing comma. Example: 

maria_gomez: ```json
{"action": "create_ticket", "args": {"description": "user issue",}, "tool_sequence": ["validate", "enqueue"]}
```

alex_kim: trailing comma inside args -> explains our schema linter failures. Did microq int8 change tokenization of punctuation?

sasha: we saw similar with zephyr-lite before - quantized decode can emit stray punctuation when generation truncates mid-token. usually tail-related.

maria_gomez: Telemetry: parse_fail_rate for funcall endpoint jumped from 0.6% -> 6.3% after onboarding on the same prompt set. Canary variance highest on short prompts with suffix-based tool calls.

devon_h: can we reproduce in local mirror? run_canary --model microq-v2-int8 --tests funcall-smoke --seed=42

maria_gomez: ran that; repro is noisy but present (~3/100). I dumped token stream; snippet shows a quote token and comma as separate tokens around boundary.

maria_gomez: ```
... "description\": "user issue",  -> tokens: ["\", ",", 125, 9]
```

alex_kim: token boundary leak. Short-term mitigations: 1) a post-invoke JSON repair that strips trailing commas and closes braces, 2) prefer end-of-structure tokens in decode finish rules for funcalls (harder).

sasha: Agree. For canary safety enable an opt-in repair hook in runtime: try parse -> if fails, run heuristics (remove trailing commas, fix dangling commas, close braces) -> reparse -> emit repaired result + metric.

maria_gomez: I'll add the opt-in flag for canary. Also want a Redwood Optimize eval: rerun 10k funcall prompts and compare repaired vs raw correctness.

devon_h: add telemetry field repaired=true/false and record original_parse_status so we don't mask regressions. Also tag repaired requests to avoid double-billing in cost dashboards.

ci-bot: deploy-notification: Canary deployed microq-v2-int8 at 2024-05-12T09:12:00Z. Artifacts: s3://canary-artifacts/microq-v2-int8/17188722/logs.tar.gz

alex_kim: medium-term: open issue to test quant recipes (per-channel vs per-tensor) and compare funcall parse-failure rates. Might be tokenizer or kernel-level side-effect.

maria_gomez: 72h plan: 1) opt-in repair hook in canary (maria), 2) telemetry + dashboard (devon), 3) 10k evaluation in Optimize (sasha), 4) quant-recipe A/B (alex). I'll PR the repair hook tonight.

devon_h: ack. If repair fixes accuracy >90% but hides regressions keep opt-in until quant fix found.

sasha: running tokenizer diffs on failing samples to find offending token ids.

maria_gomez: thanks team. tagging @alex_kim and @devon_h. :raised_hands: 

alex_kim: noted. Ill spin quant variants tomorrow and attach to canary matrix. :shipit:
